scope: Read-only portability audit of host settings and metadata. No installer or system service was executed or changed.

resolver.network_manager: enabled and active; NetworkManager.conf contains only comments/defaults
resolver.portable_action: Keep systemd-resolved enabled on the target if NetworkManager uses the systemd-resolved stub symlink; otherwise use the target distro's default NetworkManager DNS setup. Do not copy DNS server addresses from the source connection.

zram.observed: zram0 swap was active on source
zram.bundle: zram-generator is listed in packages/full.txt, but the config file is not deployed
zram.portable_action: Optionally add the small zstd config for low-memory VMs; skip if the target uses another swap/zram policy.

flatpak.bundle: The installer currently installs the Flatpak client but does not add a remote or install these application IDs.
flatpak.portable_action: Consider a separate declarative Flatpak app ID list and install it only in the full profile; the remote URL is https://dl.flathub.org/repo/.

session_and_autostart.observed_niri_session: systemd-xdg-autostart-generator generated a KeePassXC unit; it ran and exited. No Mailspring or Vesktop unit appeared in the session dependency list.
session_and_autostart.portable_action: Do not copy all source autostart entries blindly. KeePassXC is in packages/full.txt; Mailspring is absent, Vesktop is in packages/full-aur.txt. If desired, retain only intentional entries and prefer package-provided launchers over Vesktop's source-specific /usr/lib/electron40 path.

additional_source_services.systemd-resolved.service: enabled and active; its resolver stub symlink is part of the current setup
additional_source_services.seatd.service: enabled; session uses systemd/logind, so only add if target software requires it
additional_source_services.systemd-networkd.service: networkd unit files exist, but source service was not in the enabled services list; no networkd config is included
additional_source_services.daylight-gateway.service: enabled user service points into a private project directory and is not portable; intentionally omit

do_not_copy_verbatim: GPU, CPU microcode, kernel, firmware, bootloader and DKMS settings

locale.console_layout: US; the graphical niri config separately sets us,cz
locale.portable_action: Choose target locale and console settings during the Arch base install.

personal_or_project_data_excluded: browser, mail, messaging, cloud sync, IDE, AI client and game profile databases/caches
credentials, tokens, account sessions, SSH/GPG keys and network connection secrets
other_portable_gaps: XDG utility launchers under ~/.local/share/applications are not currently bundled; include only those backed by exported helper scripts/packages and render the user's home path dynamically.
Do not export every top-level ~/.config directory: several are large account/cache stores rather than reusable preferences.
